rename.to: aio: impossible to view/click on team profile twitter/GitHub links on mobile

body: Hello, guys. I wanted to fix this issue. @gkalpak, when you said: > On mobile (where there is no hover and click acts like both hover and click) it is not possible to view or click on theses links. Could you please give an idea, how it should be fixed? The reason I wanted to fix this issue is I also noticed that there're redundant scrolling bars around the card description. Please take a look at the attachment. I also wanted (and know) how to remove this bars if the description is less than card height. If the description would be bigger then card it would be scrollable. Thank you.

Sorry, for the late response, @sergeome. Assuming you are still interested to hlp address this issue (which would be awesome ❤️):

- 👍 for removing the unnecessary scrollbars.
- I am not sure how the hover/click issue should be fixed. Off the top of my head, we could have the bio/Twitter/GitHub links be always visible on mobile (instead of only on hover).
  This is more of a design question. Maybe @sjtrimble has some ideas.

<sub>
That being said, I am not a big fan of the current "flipping cards". I prefered the [expanding cards][1] we had before 😇 
</sub>

[1]: https://v2.angular.io/about/

Hello @gkalpak. 
I'm happy to address this issue. However, I've noticed that change to the cards was made about 10 months ago [link](https://github.com/angular/angular/commit/6e89f0bf8da31537e7eee438d7e0653300f3663e).

I also tried to reproduce this and I was able to navigate to a contributor's twitter and personal page on mobile. However, as you pointed, it's not very obvious unless you actually click once. 
I'm attaching video recording of my observation [here](https://photos.app.goo.gl/A25qLEpzi6umYv4x2).
Could you please suggest how should I fix that? Thank you!
I think the only thing left to do is remove the `opacity: 0` rule on `.contributor-info` when the screen is narrow.
Or even better, put it in a `@media (hover)` query. See https://caniuse.com/#feat=css-media-interaction for fairly broad availability.

issue.title: fix(docs-infra): don't hide contributor links on devices that cannot hover
